en: The image shows a group of soldiers in elaborate uniform, featuring braided jackets, tall boots, and decorative hats, posed in front of the entrance to an ornate brick building with a lion's head relief above the arch. The structure suggests a historic European architectural style, possibly late 19th or early 20th century. The photo is in black and white, adding to the historical atmosphere.
